name: Event Organization Portal - SIA Project 21 22
description:
Information Systems - academic year 21/22
Course Project
Version 1.0.1 - 20/12/2021
Consider the following scenario:

A startup intends to develop a web portal that can help people who intend to organize an event, bringing together in a single website the information concerning the guests and the various services necessary for the event itself to take place.

The platform to be developed envisages the presence of providers and guests, in addition to the organizer.

At registration, providers supply, in addition to their credentials, their personal data and the data of the company they manage (VAT number, company address, accepted payment methods).

The provider, once registered, will be able to enter the services offered by their company, each belonging to a category (catering, hairdresser, florist etc.), each of which will be associated with a virtual showcase in which the provider can upload demonstration photos, together with the corresponding prices and the hours corresponding to the particular service shown by the showcase (e.g. Hairdresser's blow-dry service has as hours 10:00-12:00 from Tuesday to Thursday, Haircut + shampoo service with hours 8:00-12:00 + 15:00-18:00 from Tuesday to Saturday).

The event organizer, identified by their tax code, at registration, in addition to choosing their credentials, will provide their personal data, residence data and their IBAN for the possible payment of the services.

The organizer, through the portal, will be able to create the event, choosing the type of event (wedding, graduation, concert…) to organize, the date, the place where it will be held and the budget planned for the organization of the event. When creating the event the organizer will be able to choose from a pre-existing list the types of service for which they are interested in receiving help (for example catering, flowers, taxi service etc.).

The organizer will also be able to add the guests to the portal, entering the corresponding data, specifying, in addition to the personal data, the email with which the guest will be identified (and which they will use to log in) and the category to which the guest belongs (relative, friend, colleague etc.).

For each guest added, the system will generate an invitation code that will be sent by email to the specified address; this code will be used by the guest as a password to access the portal.

The organizer will also have available a blog associated with their event in which the organizer or the guests can write information about the event, post photos or videos and leave their thoughts by creating new posts or commenting on the existing ones.

The organizer, once the event has been created, will be able to view, for each service chosen when creating the event, the showcases of the providers that supply the chosen type of service and to arrange an appointment compatible with the hours observed by that service, specifying the details and any special requests. The provider, through their interface, will be able to view the various appointment requests and will have to approve them. The approved requests are displayed directly in a calendar on the site associated with the event, where the organizer will be able to consult the appointments for the agreed services.

After the meeting between the provider and the organizer (in which they agree on the details of the service), the provider calculates the quotation and proceeds to upload the amount on the portal, associating it with the completed appointment.

Once the upload has taken place the organizer can choose whether to accept or reject the quotation; if it is accepted, the total amount is subtracted from the remaining budget. By accepting the amount, the organizer chooses the payment mode (instalments, deposit + balance or full amount) and the payment method (online or on site). If the payment takes place on site the provider will proceed to confirm the amount paid through the portal (in the case of payment in several instalments the provider confirms the amount of each instalment received).

At any time the organizer will be able to consult the history of the contracts (with the related status and cost) and the budget balance for the entire event.
highLevelGoals: The Event Organizer aims to efficiently create, configure, and manage all aspects of an event, including type, date, location, budget, and required service categories, through a centralized web portal.
The Event Organizer seeks to easily add guests to an event, manage their details, and facilitate their invitation and access to the event portal.
The Event Organizer desires to discover suitable service providers, view their offerings, and book appointments for necessary services in a manner compatible with their event schedule and budget.
The Event Organizer aims to maintain clear oversight of the event's budget, track service quotations, manage payments, and monitor contract history to ensure financial control.
The Event Organizer wants to foster communication and collaboration among guests and themselves through an event-specific blog, allowing for information sharing and interaction.

The Provider aims to effectively register their company, create and manage detailed showcases for their services, including demonstration photos, prices, and availability hours, to attract Event Organizers.
The Provider seeks to efficiently receive, review, approve, and manage appointment requests from Event Organizers, and to accurately upload and manage service quotations and payment confirmations.
The Provider desires a secure and reliable system for confirming payments received from Event Organizers, whether online or on-site, and for managing instalment payments.
The Guest aims to easily access relevant information about the event they are invited to, including details shared by the Event Organizer.
The Guest desires to actively participate in the event's blog by creating posts, commenting on existing content, and sharing photos or videos related to the event.
lowLevelGoals: The Event Organizer can initiate the creation of a new event by providing basic details.
The Event Organizer can select the category or type of the event from a predefined list.
The Event Organizer can input the specific date and time for the event.
The Event Organizer can provide the physical address and name of the event venue.
The Event Organizer can set a total budget for the event.
The Event Organizer can choose the types of services needed for the event from a list.
The Event Organizer can modify any previously entered information for an event.
The Event Organizer can invite a guest by entering their email address.
The Event Organizer can specify the category to which a guest belongs when adding or editing guest details.
The system automatically generates a unique invitation code for each guest, which serves as their password for the event portal.
The Event Organizer can modify the information associated with an individual guest.
The Event Organizer can trigger the sending of an email invitation to one or more guests, including their unique invitation code.
The Event Organizer can resend an invitation to a guest who may not have received it or needs a reminder.
The Event Organizer can access a comprehensive list of all guests associated with a particular event.
The Event Organizer can filter service providers based on the type of service they offer (e.g., 'Catering', 'Photography').
The Event Organizer can narrow down service providers to those available on the specified event date.
The Event Organizer can find service providers whose pricing aligns with their allocated budget.
The Event Organizer can access a provider's page to see their services, photos, and descriptions.
The Event Organizer can send a request to a provider for a price estimate for their services.
The Event Organizer can schedule a service with a provider for their event.
The Event Organizer can see a high-level overview of their event's financial allocations.
The Event Organizer can view and manage all quotations received from service providers.
The Event Organizer can accept or decline a quotation from a service provider.
Upon approving a quotation, the Event Organizer can choose the desired payment structure.
Upon approving a quotation, the Event Organizer can choose the preferred payment method.
The Event Organizer can log details of payments made for services.
The Event Organizer can review all past payments related to a particular service or provider.
The Event Organizer can view all agreements made with service providers.
The Event Organizer can publish new content to the event's dedicated blog.
The Event Organizer can modify the content of a previously published blog post.
The Event Organizer can reply to comments made by guests on their blog posts.
The Event Organizer can enrich blog posts with multimedia content.
The Provider can create an account and establish their company's presence on the platform.
The Provider can add a new service with its details to their profile.
The Provider can add images to visually represent their services.
The Provider can define the cost associated with each of their services.
The Provider can specify the days and times they are available to provide services.
The Provider can modify any information related to their listed services.
The Provider is alerted when an Event Organizer requests an appointment.
The Provider can access the specifics of a requested appointment.
The Provider can accept a requested appointment, confirming their availability.
The Provider can reject a requested appointment, indicating unavailability or other reasons.
The Provider can submit a detailed price estimate for their services to an Event Organizer.
The Provider can modify or remove previously uploaded quotations.
The Provider can record that a payment has been received from an Event Organizer.
The Provider can acknowledge and process payments made through the online system.
The Provider can manually log payments received in person.
The Provider can configure a payment schedule for services that allows for multiple payments over time.
The Provider can monitor the status of each payment within an instalment plan.
The Guest can log in or access the event's dedicated online space.
The Guest can see all essential information about the event.
The Guest can view content shared by the Event Organizer on the event blog.
The Guest can publish their own content to the event's blog.
The Guest can add their thoughts or reactions to posts made by others.
The Guest can share images related to the event on the blog.
The Guest can share video content related to the event on the blog.
